title.tr: Balkonda sohbet: diller, uyruklar, aile. μιλάω gibi fiiller
title.en: On the balcony: languages, nationalities, family. Verbs like μιλάω

blocks.tr:
Bu bölümde hangi dilleri konuştuğunu, hangi milletten olduğunu ve ailende kimlerin olduğunu anlatmayı öğreneceksin.

Anahtar nokta: *μιλάω* (konuşmak) gibi fiillerde vurgu sonda durur: **μιλάω, μιλάς, μιλάει, μιλάμε, μιλάτε, μιλάνε**. Diller de artikelsiz söylenir: **μιλάω τουρκικά** (Türkçe konuşuyorum).
blocks.en:
In this chapter you learn to say which languages you speak, which nationality you are, and who is in your family.

The key point: verbs like *μιλάω* (speak) keep the stress on the ending: **μιλάω, μιλάς, μιλάει, μιλάμε, μιλάτε, μιλάνε**. Languages are said without an article: **μιλάω τουρκικά** (I speak Turkish).

blocks.tr: Komşunla balkonda sohbet ediyorsun. Kaç dil biliyorsun? Evde hangisini konuşuyorsun? Dinlerken fiillerin sonuna dikkat et: *μιλάω, μιλάς, μιλάει, μιλάμε…*
blocks.en: You are chatting with a neighbour on the balcony. How many languages do you speak? Which one do you use at home? As you listen, watch the verb endings: *μιλάω, μιλάς, μιλάει, μιλάμε…*

blocks.tr: Dinle, sonra oku. *μιλάω, μιλάς, μιλάει, μιλάμε, μιλάτε, μιλάνε* biçimlerini şimdilik olduğu gibi al; açıklaması aşağıda. *Με τη μητέρα μου* (annemle), *με τον πατέρα μου* (babamla) ve *την οικογένειά μου* (ailemi) ifadelerini de şimdilik kalıp say: artikelin neden *τη, τον, την* olduğunu Ders 7'de göreceksin.
blocks.en: Listen, then read. Take the forms *μιλάω, μιλάς, μιλάει, μιλάμε, μιλάτε, μιλάνε* as they come; the explanation follows below. Take *με τη μητέρα μου* (with my mother), *με τον πατέρα μου* (with my father) and *την οικογένειά μου* (my family) as set phrases for now: why the article is *τη, τον, την* here comes in Lesson 7.

setting.tr: Ayşe ve komşusu Eleni balkonda konuşuyor.
setting.en: Ayşe and her neighbour Eleni are talking on the balcony.

lines.el: Καλησπέρα, Αϊσέ! Μιλάς ελληνικά πολύ καλά!
lines.tr: İyi akşamlar Ayşe! Çok iyi Yunanca konuşuyorsun!
lines.en: Good evening, Ayşe! You speak Greek very well!

lines.el: Ευχαριστώ, Ελένη! Μιλάω ελληνικά και λίγο αγγλικά. Στο σπίτι μιλάμε τουρκικά.
lines.tr: Teşekkürler Eleni! Yunanca ve biraz İngilizce konuşuyorum. Evde Türkçe konuşuyoruz.
lines.en: Thank you, Eleni! I speak Greek and a little English. At home we speak Turkish.

lines.el: Εγώ μιλάω ελληνικά και γερμανικά. Η μητέρα μου είναι Γερμανίδα και ο πατέρας μου είναι Έλληνας.
lines.tr: Ben Yunanca ve Almanca konuşuyorum. Annem Alman, babam Yunan.
lines.en: I speak Greek and German. My mother is German and my father is Greek.

lines.el: Ωραία! Στο σπίτι σας μιλάτε γερμανικά;
lines.tr: Ne güzel! Sizin evde Almanca konuşuyor musunuz?
lines.en: Nice! Do you speak German at your house?

lines.el: Με τη μητέρα μου μιλάω γερμανικά. Με τον πατέρα μου μιλάμε ελληνικά.
lines.tr: Annemle Almanca konuşuyorum. Babamla Yunanca konuşuyoruz.
lines.en: I speak German with my mother. With my father we speak Greek.

lines.el: Και ο αδελφός σου; Μιλάει γερμανικά;
lines.tr: Ya erkek kardeşin? O Almanca konuşuyor mu?
lines.en: And your brother? Does he speak German?

lines.el: Ναι, ο αδελφός μου και η αδελφή μου μιλάνε γερμανικά και αγγλικά. Και η οικογένειά σου; Είναι στην Αθήνα;
lines.tr: Evet, erkek kardeşim de kız kardeşim de Almanca ve İngilizce konuşuyor. Ya senin ailen? Atina'da mı?
lines.en: Yes, my brother and my sister speak German and English. And your family? Are they in Athens?

lines.el: Όχι, η οικογένειά μου είναι στη Σμύρνη. Ο πατέρας μου είναι γιατρός και η μητέρα μου είναι δασκάλα. Αγαπάω πολύ την οικογένειά μου.
lines.tr: Hayır, ailem İzmir'de. Babam doktor, annem öğretmen. Ailemi çok seviyorum.
lines.en: No, my family is in Smyrna. My father is a doctor and my mother is a teacher. I love my family very much.

blocks.tr:
Ders 3'te *δουλεύω, δουλεύεις, δουλεύει…* gibi fiilleri gördün; orada vurgu hep kökte kalıyordu (*δου-λεύ-ω*). Bir grup fiilde ise vurgu **ekin başındaki -ά-** üzerindedir: *μι-λά-ω* (konuşmak). Dilbilgisi kitapları bu gruba *B1 fiilleri* der (sınav seviyesi B1 ile ilgisi yok). Ekler: **-άω, -άς, -άει, -άμε, -άτε, -άνε**.
Sağ sütunda aynı fiilin kısa biçimleri var: **μιλώ, μιλά, μιλούν**. İkisi de doğru ve ikisini de duyacaksın; anlam aynı. Konuşurken ortadaki sütunu kullan. *μιλάς* ve *μιλάτε* iki sütunda da aynıdır; *μιλάμε* da her yerde kullanılır (*μιλούμε* resmî ve seyrek).
blocks.en:
In Lesson 3 you met verbs like *δουλεύω, δουλεύεις, δουλεύει…*, where the stress stays on the stem (*δου-λεύ-ω*). In another group the stress falls on **the -ά- of the ending**: *μι-λά-ω* (speak). Grammar books call this group *B1 verbs* (nothing to do with the B1 exam level). The endings are **-άω, -άς, -άει, -άμε, -άτε, -άνε**.
The right column gives short forms of the same verb: **μιλώ, μιλά, μιλούν**. Both are correct and you will hear both; they mean the same. When you speak, use the middle column. *μιλάς* and *μιλάτε* are the same in both columns, and *μιλάμε* is used everywhere (*μιλούμε* is formal and rare).

note.tr: İkinci tekil *μιλάς*'tır; *μιλάεις* diye bir biçim yoktur. Üçüncü tekil *-ει* ile yazılır: *μιλάει*. Çoğulda *μιλάνε* yerine kısaca *μιλάν* da denir.
note.en: The second person is *μιλάς*; there is no *μιλάεις*. The third person singular is written with *-ει*: *μιλάει*. In the plural, *μιλάνε* is also shortened to *μιλάν*.

title.en: The same pattern: ρωτάω, αγαπάω, ξυπνάω

blocks.tr: Aynı ekler başka fiillerde de çalışır: *ρωτάω* (sormak), *αγαπάω* (sevmek), *ξυπνάω* (uyanmak). *ρωτάω* ve *αγαπάω*'dan sonra sorduğun ya da sevdiğin kişi gelir: *ρωτάω τη μητέρα μου* (anneme soruyorum), *αγαπάω την οικογένειά μου* (ailemi seviyorum). Bunları şimdilik kalıp olarak öğren; fiilden sonra artikelin neden *τον / την / τη* olduğu Ders 7'nin konusu.
blocks.en: The same endings work for other verbs: *ρωτάω* (ask), *αγαπάω* (love), *ξυπνάω* (wake up). After *ρωτάω* and *αγαπάω* comes the person you ask or love: *ρωτάω τη μητέρα μου* (I ask my mother), *αγαπάω την οικογένειά μου* (I love my family). Learn these as set patterns for now; why the article becomes *τον / την / τη* after a verb is Lesson 7.

note.tr: Kısa biçimler de aynı kalıpta: *ρωτώ, ρωτά, ρωτούν(ε)*; *αγαπώ, αγαπά, αγαπούν(ε)*; *ξυπνώ, ξυπνά, ξυπνούν(ε)*.
note.en: The short forms follow the same pattern: *ρωτώ, ρωτά, ρωτούν(ε)*; *αγαπώ, αγαπά, αγαπούν(ε)*; *ξυπνώ, ξυπνά, ξυπνούν(ε)*.

items.el: Η Ελένη αγαπάει τον πατέρα της.

note.en: *της*, because the owner is Eleni, a woman.

blocks.tr:
*μιλάω* fiilinden sonra dil **artikelsiz** gelir: *μιλάω τουρκικά, ελληνικά, αγγλικά, γερμανικά*. Türkçedeki *-ce* gibi düşün: *Yunanca konuşuyorum* = *μιλάω ελληνικά*. Dil adları **küçük harfle** yazılır. Bunlar aslında çoğul nötr kelimelerdir (sözlükte *τα ελληνικά*); kuralı sonraki derslerde gelecek, şimdilik *μιλάω* ile kalıp olarak öğren.
*πολύ καλά* (çok iyi) genelde dilden sonra, *λίγο* (biraz) dilden önce gelir.
blocks.en:
After *μιλάω* the language comes **without an article**: *μιλάω τουρκικά, ελληνικά, αγγλικά, γερμανικά*. Language names are written with a **small letter**. They are really neuter plural words (the dictionary gives *τα ελληνικά*); the rule comes in later lessons, so for now learn them with *μιλάω* as set phrases.
*πολύ καλά* (very well) usually comes after the language, *λίγο* (a little) before it.

items.el: Η Αϊσέ μιλάει τουρκικά και ελληνικά.

blocks.tr: Türkçede *Türk* hem erkek hem kadın için tek kelimedir. Yunancada erkek ve kadın için **iki ayrı kelime** vardır; ikisini birlikte öğren: **ο Τούρκος / η Τουρκάλα**. Kadın biçimlerinin çoğu **-ίδα** ile biter: *Ελληνίδα, Γερμανίδα*. Kadın kendinden söz ederken kendi biçimini kullanır: *Είμαι Τουρκάλα.* Uyruk adları **büyük harfle** yazılır; dil adları küçük harfle.
blocks.en: English has one word (*Greek*) for a man or a woman; Greek has **two**. Learn them as a pair: **ο Τούρκος / η Τουρκάλα**. Many women's forms end in **-ίδα**: *Ελληνίδα, Γερμανίδα*. A woman uses her own form: *Είμαι Τουρκάλα.* Nationalities are written with a **capital letter**; languages are written with a small letter.

note.tr: Kadın biçimi ayrı bir kelime gibi öğrenilir; *Τουρκάλα* diğerlerinden farklı biter.
note.en: Learn each woman's form as its own word; *Τουρκάλα* ends differently from the others.

title.tr: Aile: η μητέρα μου, ο πατέρας μου
title.en: Family: η μητέρα μου, ο πατέρας μου

blocks.tr: Aile kelimeleri Ders 4'teki sahiplik sözcükleriyle gelir: **η μητέρα μου**, **ο πατέρας σου**. Bu tablodaki kelimelerin hiçbiri sondan üçüncü hecede vurgulu değildir; bu yüzden **ikinci vurgu yok**. Ama Ders 4'ten hatırla: *η οικογένειά μου* ikinci vurgu alır.
blocks.en: Family words come with the possessives of Lesson 4: **η μητέρα μου**, **ο πατέρας σου**. None of the words in this table is stressed on the third syllable from the end, so there is **no second accent**. But remember from Lesson 4: *η οικογένειά μου* does take one.

note.tr: Ayrıca: *η γιαγιά* (büyükanne) ve *το παιδί* (çocuk, Ders 3). Konuşmada *αδελφός, αδελφή* yerine çok sık *αδερφός, αδερφή* duyarsın; ikisi de doğru.
note.en: Also: *η γιαγιά* (grandmother) and *το παιδί* (child, from Lesson 3). In speech you will very often hear *αδερφός, αδερφή* for *αδελφός, αδελφή*; both are correct.

items.en: Her sister is a university student.

items.el: Ο γιος μας σπουδάζει στο πανεπιστήμιο.
items.en: Our son studies at the university.

items.el: Η γιαγιά μου μένει στη Σμύρνη.

blocks.tr: Bu dersin kelimeleri: diller, uyruklar, aile ve üç yeni fiil. Bölümü bitirince oturumlarına gelecekler.
blocks.en: The words of this lesson: languages, nationalities, family and three new verbs. They come into your sessions once you finish the chapter.

blocks.tr: **Dil ile uyruğu karıştırma.** Dil artikelsiz ve küçük harfle: *μιλάω τουρκικά*. Kişi büyük harfle: *Είμαι Τουρκάλα*.
blocks.en: **Do not mix up language and nationality.** The language has no article and a small letter: *μιλάω τουρκικά*. The person has a capital: *Είμαι Τουρκάλα*.

blocks.tr: **Türkçeyle karşılaştır.** Türkçede de dil ile kişi ayrı kelimelerdir: *Türkçe / Türk*. Yunancada da öyle: *ελληνικά* (Yunanca), *Έλληνας* (Yunan). Fark şu: Türkçede *Türk* tek kelime, Yunancada erkek ve kadın ayrı: *Τούρκος, Τουρκάλα*.
blocks.en: **Compared with English.** English has one word for the person and often one for the language (*Greek*). Greek separates them: *ελληνικά* (the language), *Έλληνας* and *Ελληνίδα* (the people).

blocks.tr: Sözlü sınavın ısınma kısmında genellikle kendin, ailen ve bildiğin diller hakkında soru sorulur. Kısa ve tam cümlelerle cevap ver: *Είμαι Τουρκάλα* (erkeksen *Τούρκος*). *Μιλάω τουρκικά και ελληνικά. Ο πατέρας μου είναι γιατρός.*
blocks.en: The warm-up of the speaking test usually asks about you, your family and your languages. Answer in short, full sentences: *Είμαι Τουρκάλα* (a man says *Τούρκος*). *Μιλάω τουρκικά και ελληνικά. Ο πατέρας μου είναι γιατρός.*

blocks.tr: Şimdi sen dene: fiil biçimleri, diller, uyruk ve aile.
blocks.en: Now you try: verb forms, languages, nationality and family.
